2609.26488.title: Spoken Language Models that Think Aloud
2609.26488.paper_summary: While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has improved the capability of language models, directly applying it to Spoken Language Models (SLMs) may introduce long silent intervals under the serial "think-then-speak" paradigm, disrupting real-time spoken interaction. To address this issue, we propose an asynchronous think-aloud framework for reasoning-based SLMs within the Thinker-Talker architecture. The framework maintains a primary reasoning stream for logical deduction and a lightweight think-aloud stream that generates short, task-grounded progress utterances conditioned on the user input and the evolving reasoning state. A dynamic balance strategy coordinates the two streams at runtime, triggering additional think-aloud speech to avoid silent gaps and canceling pending utterances when the final response becomes ready. Experiments on spoken reasoning and question-answering benchmarks show that our approach substantially reduces user-audible silence during reasoning while maintaining answer accuracy comparable to that of a serial "think-then-speak" baseline, demonstrating the potential of asynchronous think-aloud for responsive interaction in SLMs.
2609.26488.paper_summary_zh: 雖然思維鏈（CoT）推理提升了語言模型的能力，但直接將其應用於口語語言模型（SLMs）可能會在序列“思考後再說”的範式下引入長時間的沉默間隔，干擾即時的口語互動。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一個非同步思考大聲說的框架，適用於基於推理的SLMs，並融入思考者-講者架構。該框架維持一個主要的推理流，用於邏輯推導，以及一個輕量級的思考大聲說流，根據用戶輸入和不斷演變的推理狀態生成短小的、以任務為基礎的進度發言。一個動態平衡策略在運行時協調這兩個流，觸發額外的思考大聲說，以避免沉默間隙，並在最終回應準備就緒時取消待發言。針對口語推理和問答基準的實驗顯示，我們的方法在推理過程中顯著減少了用戶可聽到的沉默，同時保持與序列“思考後再說”基準相當的答案準確性，展示了非同步思考大聲說在SLMs中實現響應互動的潛力。
